description.text: It is also availble for the 1-year advanced program. Those who does not meet the requirement of HSK score can at first apply for the Chinese Language Program for one year before studying in the relevant colleges or departments.

duration.text: The Demography at Central China Normal University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2736 USD/per year ￥ 19700 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.Undergraduate school transcript 4.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents
